gaps.title: A real /estimate URL as the request_estimate action target (not /#quote)
gaps.detail: JSON-LD potentialAction, the registry action and every machine surface point at /estimate and /estimate#form.

gaps.title: One business entity in JSON-LD (no per-page LocalBusiness/ProfessionalService duplicates)
gaps.detail: Service-area pages emitted a second LocalBusiness with a dangling #business parent; commercial pages emitted a ProfessionalService #localbusiness. Both replaced by WebPage nodes that reference /#organization.

gaps.title: Versioned agentic primitives API with provenance (/api/v1) and OpenAPI
gaps.detail: Stages 5, 13, 16–20. Absent before this pass.

gaps.title: A /pricing page: table first, conditions, written-price rule, stable row ids
gaps.detail: Every Price primitive cites /pricing#<band>. The page did not exist (404, probe 2026-09-05).

gaps.title: Google Business Profile shows no phone number
gaps.detail: README (live 2026-09-04): "Add place's phone number" on the GBP card. The site, JSON-LD, llms.txt and /api/v1/entity all publish the same number; the profile does not.
gaps.blocker: HUMAN DECISION REQUIRED — owner adds the phone in the GBP dashboard.

gaps.title: ecowoods-app.vercel.app serves a superseded copy of the site
gaps.detail: vercel.json redirects the host, but the alias is served by a project this repository does not deploy (README §5). pnpm seo:hosts watches it.
gaps.blocker: EXTERNAL AUTHORIZATION — delete or re-point the alias in the Vercel team that owns it.

gaps.title: potentialAction (QuoteAction → /estimate, CommunicateAction → tel:) on the organisation node
gaps.detail: Protocol §17. Absent before this pass.

gaps.title: JSON-LD service descriptions derived from SERVICES (no hand-typed copy)
gaps.detail: root-schema.ts carried a second copy of the six services; dust-free sanding had already drifted from the visible blurb.

gaps.title: Southern Ontario beyond the GTA as a published service area
gaps.detail: The protocol names all of Southern Ontario; the site, JSON-LD and claims publish Toronto & the GTA. The registry models Southern Ontario municipalities with coverage "assessment" and the matcher answers them honestly (requires_assessment + estimate action). Flipping them to "published" is a public coverage claim.
gaps.blocker: HUMAN DECISION REQUIRED — Protocol §23: adding a municipality to the public list. Prepared: lib/registry/locations.ts ASSESSMENT_MUNICIPALITIES (rename to published + add pages with local content).

gaps.title: llms.txt in the llmstxt.org shape, curated, with an Optional long tail
gaps.detail: Was a 65 KB prose sitemap. Now H1 + blockquote + curated link sections + Optional; llms-full.txt carries the bulk.

gaps.title: A /contact page carrying the NAP with citable fragment ids
gaps.detail: Stage 28: directories and agents want one page whose main content is the NAP.

gaps.title: Bing Places lists "Ecowoods Inc." with wrong hours and the www host
gaps.detail: README (live 2026-09-04): name "Ecowoods Inc.", website https://www.ecowoods.ca, hours Fri 08:00–22:00 / Sat 08:00–16:00. Must match the locked NAP.
gaps.dependency: owner login to Bing Places for Business
gaps.blocker: HUMAN DECISION REQUIRED — owner edits the listing (Protocol §23: listing changes are business actions).

gaps.title: YellowPages, 411.ca and TrustedPros still point their website field at the retired domain
gaps.detail: README (live 2026-09-04). One DNS change on ecowoodshardwood.com (301 to canonical) corrects all three for crawlers at once.
gaps.blocker: EXTERNAL AUTHORIZATION — DNS at the registrar, or Apache upload of old-domain/.htaccess. Redirect configs are generated and checked (pnpm domain:check).

gaps.title: rel="alternate" type="text/markdown" in <head> and a Link header on every page with a twin
gaps.detail: Stage 25. No page advertised its .md twin before this pass.

gaps.title: /md index and twins for home, hubs, pricing, reviews, estimate, contact and the head-term pages
gaps.detail: /md and /md/services returned 404 in production (probe 2026-09-05).

gaps.title: verify-reviews.mjs resolves identifier references (was failing on main)
gaps.detail: The guard expected href literals; constants now reference HOMESTARS_CANONICAL/GOOGLE_PLACE. pnpm verify failed at baseline.

gaps.title: "When this is the wrong service" on every service page
gaps.detail: Protocol §15.2 #3. Rendered from lib/registry WRONG_WHEN, served by /api/v1/services/{id}.

gaps.title: Homepage FAQ wording differs from FAQ_ITEMS on three answers
gaps.detail: scripts/schema-baseline.json records three faq-divergence entries (supplier brand names on the homepage copy only). Which wording survives is a positioning decision.
gaps.blocker: HUMAN DECISION REQUIRED — pick one wording; then delete the three baseline entries.

gaps.title: Claims still marked unsourced in content/claims.ts
gaps.detail: 8 claim(s) carry status 'unsourced' (deadline UNSOURCED_DEADLINE). They are fenced out of schema; `pnpm seo:claims --strict` will fail once the deadline is enforced.
gaps.blocker: HUMAN DECISION REQUIRED — a source per claim, or retire the claim.

gaps.title: GA4 measurement id set in Vercel
gaps.detail: README §6: NEXT_PUBLIC_GA_MEASUREMENT_ID pending. Conversion events fire only when set. `pnpm env:check` reports it.
gaps.blocker: Cannot read Vercel env from the repository; run `vercel env pull && pnpm env:check`.

gaps.title: ETag + 304 on machine JSON
gaps.detail: /api/knowledge, /api/market and /api/health return no ETag (live probe 2026-09-05). /api/v1 does. Extending the same helper to the legacy routes is a follow-up.

gaps.title: Two HomeStars profiles (2776939-ecowoods, 2897115-ecowood)
gaps.detail: Both are declared as sameAs; only the canonical one is counted as review evidence. A merge consolidates the record.
gaps.blocker: HUMAN DECISION REQUIRED — owner asks HomeStars support to merge.

gaps.title: CSP keeps 'unsafe-inline' in script-src
gaps.detail: Deliberate (nonces would force 287 prerendered pages dynamic); a report-only ladder exists. Not weakened, not fixed.

gaps.title: IndexNow submission on production deploy
gaps.detail: .github/workflows/indexnow.yml fires on deployment_status success with INDEXNOW_KEY. Confirm the secret exists in the GitHub repository settings.
gaps.blocker: Cannot read GitHub secrets from the repository; verify in Settings → Secrets.

gaps.title: Rate limits are in-memory per lambda instance
gaps.detail: lib/rate-limit.ts. Effective ceiling is limit × instances; a durable store (Vercel KV / Upstash) would make it exact. Adds a dependency — deferred.
